description: This file defines a Perl controller class for handling email change processes within a web application, including methods for preparing email data for current and new email notifications.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Email::ChangeEmail
classes.description: A controller class for managing email change workflows, extending the base Coocook::Controller class.

methods.name: to_current_email
methods.description: Prepares and stores data related to the user's current email for rendering the email change confirmation page.

methods.name: to_new_email
methods.description: Prepares and stores data related to the user's new email and verification URL for email change confirmation.
